QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Big Man Off-campus
QuestInfo.0: #p9400216# refuses to leave the castle unless #p9400217# first. Convince #p9400217# to go outside!
QuestInfo.1: #p9400217# has been watching your efforts. Thanks to his great size, he has been able to see the beautiful world beyond the castle walls. He's thought about going out, but he's too big to fit through the castle gates... You should make a hole in the castle wall so he can leave!\r\n\r\nEat a #e#t2436086:##n to #egrow big, then climb on top of the walls and start jumping!
QuestInfo.2: You made a hole in the castle wall, and #p9400217# was able to go outside.\r\nAlthough he's not sure if breaking the wall or leaving the castle were good ideas, he is grateful for all you've done.

default.0: The castle gates are far too small for me to pass through.
